Handelstaal tusschen Aucaner-boschnegers en Indianen gebruikelijk
Joeka-Trio

endangerment.comment: Ndyuka-Trio Pidgin (4866-njt) = Dormant (Used until 1960s by Ndyuka, Trio and Wayana peoples for trading. Increasing travel to the coast cut back on that trade, and also gave some opportunity to use Sranan [srn] in contact with the Ndyuka. Few Ndyuka men, even older ones, now know it. Used rarely now.) [Lewis et al. 2015](cldf:lewis:paul:etal:ed:15)
